categories.main_business_segments: The Group operates primarily in three segments: manufacture and sale of BMW vehicles and components through its associate BMW Brilliance Automotive Ltd. (BBA); manufacture and sale of non-BMW vehicles and automotive components through subsidiaries including Jinbei (Shenyang) Automotive Co., Ltd. (JSA), Ningbo Yumin Machinery Industrial Co., Ltd., and Mianyang Brilliance Ruian Automotive Components Co., Ltd.; and provision of auto financing services through its subsidiary Brilliance–BEA Auto Finance Co., Ltd. (BBAFC).
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The Group employs advanced manufacturing technologies including smart manufacturing with artificial intelligence and digital technologies for precision quality control, especially at the BMW Brilliance Shenyang plant. It focuses on aluminium alloy lightweight components, camshaft manufacturing for gasoline and electric vehicle engines, and is advancing in intelligent cockpit and display assembly through a joint venture with TCL. The production methods emphasize localisation, cost-effective solutions, and integration of new energy vehicle (NEV) technologies.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The Group serves primarily the automotive industry in China, targeting passenger vehicle markets including sedans, SUVs, and new energy vehicles (NEVs). Customers include individual consumers, families, and commercial vehicle operators. The auto financing segment serves retail customers for vehicle purchases, including NEV buyers. The Group also exports vehicles, mainly BMW models, to overseas markets.
categories.geographic_coverage: The Group's operations and sales are mainly concentrated in the People's Republic of China, with manufacturing bases in Shenyang, Ningbo, Mianyang, and Shanghai. It also has sales exposure to other Asian countries, Latin America, Europe, and other regions through exports. The Group’s registered office is in Bermuda, with its principal place of business in Hong Kong.
categories.supply_chain_position: The Group operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the automotive supply chain, including vehicle manufacturing (both BMW and non-BMW brands), automotive components production, and auto financing services. It is involved in both assembly and component manufacturing, as well as financial services supporting vehicle sales.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include expanding NEV production and technology, localising production and supply chains, and investing in intelligent cockpit technologies through a joint venture with TCL. The Group is preparing for the production of BMW's Neue Klasse model starting in 2026, focusing on digitalisation, innovation, and design. It also emphasizes product transformation, lightweight aluminium alloy components, and sustainable growth in auto financing with a focus on NEVs.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly from the sale of vehicles and automotive components, both BMW and non-BMW, recognized at a point in time. The Group also earns interest and service charge income from its auto financing services. Additionally, it receives dividends from its associate BBA and engages in strategic investments and joint ventures to diversify income streams.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The Group competes in the highly competitive Chinese automotive market, particularly in passenger vehicles and NEVs. Its major competitor context includes other automotive manufacturers and component suppliers in China and globally. The Group holds a significant position through its joint venture with BMW, which is a premium brand, and through its non-BMW vehicle and component manufacturing subsidiaries. It also competes in the auto financing sector against other financial institutions.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: For the year ended 2024, the Group reported revenue of approximately RMB1.096 billion, a slight decrease from the previous year, with a net profit attributable to equity holders of RMB3.1 billion, down 60% from 2023. The Group’s total assets were about RMB29.1 billion, with a gearing ratio of 0.07. The Group has experienced fluctuations due to market competition, restructuring, and economic conditions but maintains a substantial scale with ongoing investments in production capacity and technology.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The Group emphasizes premium quality and technological innovation, particularly through its partnership with BMW, delivering 'Sheer driving pleasure' with advanced vehicle features. It differentiates itself by integrating smart manufacturing, AI, and digital technologies, focusing on NEVs and intelligent cockpit systems. The Group also offers diversified automotive financing solutions tailored to the growing NEV market, supporting customer needs with prudent risk management and service innovation.
